title: Rosalind and the Hymn
author: Quentin Voss
blurb: Kestrel Nystrom, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
